description: 과학기술정보통신부 우정사업본부_우체국위치 정보 [telecommunications] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 과학기술정보통신부 우정사업본부. 우체국이나 365코너, 무인창구, 우체통 등의 운영시간 주소 위치정보등을 공개함으로써 가까운 시설물 및 정보를 안내하여 우체국을 편리하게 이용할 수 있게 함 컬럼명: 구분번호, 주소, 범위, 전화번호, 팩스번호, 국문 주소, 영문주소, 365코너유무, 우체국운영시간, 금융서비스 시간, 수집 및 서비스... Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 과학기술정보통신부 우정사업본부. Its tags are 정보/통신, 정보이론, 정보검색, 과학기술. It offers 1 resource(s) in xml. The portal shows 2021-06-16 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network deployment studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
